memory: For problems involving percentages, start by finding the part of the whole and then multiply
When adding fractions with different denominators, convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with a common denominator before adding
If you know the total cost of items and their individual prices, multiply the number of items by the average price per item to estimate the total revenue or profit
